description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core minimal API endpoint for creating a new catalog item in an e-commerce application. It includes route setup, request handling, validation for duplicate items, and creation of catalog items with picture URI handling.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for creating catalog items, handling route registration, request validation, and persistence.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the POST route for creating a catalog item with authorization and endpoint mapping.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the creation logic for a new catalog item, including duplicate check, creation, and response.
